pruner_padding: Original right padding to 8192 with attention mask; no shortened input tensor.
attention: SDPA with query-axis tiles of 256 and full key/value context; tested against untiled SDPA.
population: Three existing development questions; disjoint from fixed eight reported subset. All six balanced cells retained.
order: Alternate full/pruner by question index ordinal. Two workers maximum; matched controls use fresh executions.
repeat_semantics: Exactly one development repetition. Further fixed-eight confirmation needs a separately frozen protocol and all three repetitions.
judge_prompt: Exact released five-dimensional SWE-QA rubric; low reasoning, max output 4096; unchanged from the prior study.
metrics: provider cumulative input+output tokens including cached input
paper_target: Table 2, Streamlink, GLM-4.6, full and SWE-Pruner rows.
primary_analysis: All three paired questions, one execution each, descriptive development screen. No outcome-based retries or question replacement.
token_accounting: Independent API ledger, checked against corrected runner. Report a separate 2x replay of the released double-counting metric, with unknown linkage to the published table.
retry_policy: One additional attempt only for demonstrated infrastructure/export/pruning-service failure. Retain all attempts. Low scores never trigger replacement.
modification_phase: After matched reproduction behavior has been investigated, freeze and evaluate lossless recovery independently.
unresolved_alignment: Original model served as azure/glm-4.6 through a ByteDance gateway; this run uses the accessible Z.AI endpoint via OpenRouter.
Authors exact inference kernel and checkpoint revision unrecorded; published checkpoint replay is measured.
Released Streamlink and Reflex token columns cross-match the paper rows; preserve both sources.
Authors snapshot included additional unshared helper files.
Judge provider and inference details remain incompletely specified.
workspace: Clean copies of Conan, Reflex and Streamlink at ./swe-repos/{repository}, matching the recorded shared source-root layout. Authors unpublished helper files and evaluation materials are absent.
scope_change: User requests small-scope alignment first; full48 expansion deferred. Approved project ceiling remains USD12.
expected_behavior: Lower end-to-end tokens with comparable mean quality; report all fixed questions and interpret quality uncertainty, activation and missing evidence before scaling.
precision_basis: Released online_serving.py omits dtype; direct loading in pinned Transformers produces FP32 parameters. Published checkpoint contains BF16 backbone tensors and 15 FP32 tensors; previous explicit BF16 cast rounded the latter.
previous_stage: Complete first repetition in runs/subset/formal uses BF16 weights and remains a separate diagnostic.
intervention: Only first native API request requires a nonempty hint. Every later request restores the original optional field, allowing unfiltered rereads. No author commands, outputs, answers, or hints enter live execution.
comparator: Matched full-output control uses identical schemas, first-request priming, system/user prompts, terminal repair and model. Only the executor's filtering branch differs.
screening: Proceed to fixed-eight confirmation only if at least two of three pruner tasks activate after their first API request, paired aggregate tokens decline, and mean quality decline is at most 2% relative. Otherwise retain the candidate as failed diagnostic. These thresholds are set before this pilot.
target: Working small-scope confirmation target: at least 40% end-to-end token reduction (within 10 percentage points of author same-eight 49.9%) with mean quality decline at most 2%. Report cluster uncertainty and all three repeats. This is an engineering target, not a guaranteed outcome.
interpretation: Serving-policy adaptation, separate from exact-contract reproduction and raw-observation recovery modification. Gateway internals remain unknown.
budget: Estimated USD0.2-0.3 development pilot inside USD12. No full48 expansion or extra approval assumed.
